A relay update can be operational news without changing the Nostr protocol.

Nostream 3.2.0 adds an optional two-relay HAProxy stack with readiness checks and rolling replacement. It also adds a default-off setting that can hide events from REQ and COUNT when configured trusted moderators submit actionable NIP-56 reports.

The release fixes multi-tag and multi-filter queries that could silently omit valid events. Its deployment PR validated Compose and HAProxy configuration, but explicitly says a live WebSocket cutover was not tested.

We separated the shipped controls from what still depends on operator policy and production validation.

Nostream 3.2.0 adds an optional HAProxy blue/green relay stack, default-off action on trusted NIP-56 reports, and fixes for quiet multi-filter query failures.

The deployment configuration was validated upstream, but a live WebSocket cutover was not tested. Moderation remains an operator choice and does not remove events from other relays.
